peer_results.rationale: Bank of America's disclosures focus on the optimization of its physical banking network (reducing ATMs) and general retail footprint statistics, rather than specific software upgrades or cybersecurity software controls comparable to Citi's ATM software resiliency initiative.

comparisons.peer_summary: The cybersecurity risk management framework includes training, identity and access management, application and software security, infrastructure security, mobile security, data security, cloud computing governance, technology operations, and third-party risk management.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citi and Goldman Sachs disclose specific software security initiatives as part of their broader technology and security resilience efforts. Citi's disclosure focuses on the operational execution of upgrading ATM software to enhance customer security, whereas Goldman Sachs details 'application and software security' as a core component of its cybersecurity risk management framework, including software change management. While Citi reports a completed infrastructure upgrade for end-user devices, GS describes the ongoing governance and control framework for software security across its enterprise.

sentences.text: • Upgraded 100% of Citi's more than 2,300 ATMs in North America, Singapore, Hong Kong and the UAE to next-generation software for better customer security and monitoring
• Application and software security, including software change management, open source software, and backup and restoration;

peer_results.rationale: JPMorgan's candidate disclosures concern country risk monitoring policies and the Cyber Operations function's role in detecting cyber attacks. These topics are distinct from Citi's specific disclosure regarding the completion of a software upgrade for ATM hardware to improve security and monitoring.

Morgan Stanley's candidate disclosures address wealth management loan quality/collateralization and the limitations of Value-at-Risk (VaR) statistical models. These are financial risk metrics unrelated to Citi's operational technology disclosure about ATM software upgrades.
